cues.en: Mike: Let's see the simple regression done in action.
cues.zh: Mike：看看簡單迴歸實際如何運作。

cues.en: I'm going to start this coding video in really similar ways to what I've done previously in the course, where first I'm gonna go through, without using any special toolboxes,
cues.zh: 這支程式影片與先前類似，首先不使用任何特殊工具箱，

cues.en: and just run through all the math of the entire regression in MATLAB.
cues.zh: 在 MATLAB 走過整個迴歸的全部數學。

cues.en: And then, at the end, I will show you the way to use a function, just to simplify matters.
cues.zh: 最後，再示範使用函式，簡化工作。

cues.en: Okay, so let's get started.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: This is going to be the example of the effects of sleep on food spending in Fiji.
cues.zh: 使用斐濟睡眠影響食物花費的例子。

cues.en: So this is just all the numbers that I used in the previous video.
cues.zh: 就是上一支影片的所有數字。

cues.en: So we start by plotting the data.
cues.zh: 先畫出資料。

cues.en: So yeah, it's just the same thing you saw in the slides.
cues.zh: 與投影片看到的相同。

cues.en: Okay, so what I'm gonna do here is actually run through manual regression.
cues.zh: 這裡實際手動完成迴歸。

cues.en: So by manual, I mean that I'm not using any particular MATLAB function.
cues.zh: 手動指的是不使用特定 MATLAB 迴歸函式。

cues.en: I'm going to just create the design matrix and solve for the beta coefficients completely, you know, just sort of on my own here, with code.
cues.zh: 自行建立設計矩陣，再完全透過程式碼，求解 beta 係數。

cues.en: So let's start by looking at the design matrix, desmat.
cues.zh: 先看設計矩陣 desmat。

cues.en: So this is a vector of ones, and then we have our vector of the number of time, or number of hours spent sleeping.
cues.zh: 這是一條全為 1 的向量，再加上睡眠時數的向量。

cues.en: So this is our design matrix.
cues.zh: 這就是設計矩陣。

cues.en: The intercept, and the independent variable here.
cues.zh: 截距，以及自變數。

cues.en: And then, here is where I'm computing the beta parameters.
cues.zh: 這裡計算 beta 參數。

cues.en: So these are the regression coefficients.
cues.zh: 也就是迴歸係數。

cues.en: And it turns out that the formula for computing the left inverse that I showed you in the previous slide, we can implement that in MATLAB using this forward slash here.
cues.zh: 先前投影片中左反矩陣的計算公式，在 MATLAB 可以用這個斜線運算子實作。

cues.en: So this gives us our two parameters, and we see that those are around 63 and minus 2.5.
cues.zh: 得到兩個參數，大約是 63 與負 2.5。

cues.en: Those are the numbers that I showed in the slides.
cues.zh: 就是投影片中的數字。

cues.en: So now we need our predicted data, often called yHat, as you know.
cues.zh: 接著需要預測資料，你知道，通常叫作 yHat。

cues.en: So here I'm calling it yHat.
cues.zh: 這裡也叫 yHat。

cues.en: And so, that's just the design matrix times the beta values.
cues.zh: 就是設計矩陣乘 beta 值。

cues.en: So essentially what we're doing is we're saying, let me go back to this.
cues.zh: 基本上是在說，回到這裡。

cues.en: So what we're doing is we're saying 62.84 times 1, plus -2.496 times all of these numbers.
cues.zh: 用 62.84 乘 1，再加上負 2.496 乘這些數字。

cues.en: And I'm implementing that using matrix notation, matrix multiplication notation.
cues.zh: 透過矩陣符號、矩陣乘法來實作。

cues.en: But essentially this is just scaling each column in the design matrix by each corresponding beta parameter,
cues.zh: 基本上，設計矩陣的每一欄，先乘以對應 beta 參數，

cues.en: and then summing up over those two different columns.
cues.zh: 再將兩欄的結果加總。

cues.en: Okay, so that gives us our predicted data, and now I'm gonna plot the predicted results on top.
cues.zh: 如此得到預測資料，再把預測結果疊畫上去。

cues.en: So you can see that here I'm plotting data 1, so this is the number of hours slept, by yHat, and that is the prediction.
cues.zh: 這裡畫 data1，也就是睡眠時數，相對於預測值 yHat。

cues.en: So the prediction is these blue lines, the actual data is the black lines, and then I'm drawing the residuals on here as well, just like I showed you in the slides in the previous video.
cues.zh: 藍線是預測，黑線是實際資料，也畫上殘差，與上一支影片投影片的示範相同。

cues.en: Okay, so that gives us our beta coefficients.
cues.zh: 這就得到 beta 係數。

cues.en: And now, I'm not actually going through the additional work of computing the R squared and the F statistic here, although that's gonna be your job very soon,
cues.zh: 這裡沒有繼續計算 R 平方與 F 統計量，不過很快就會輪到你做，

cues.en: in the next video.
cues.zh: 在下一支影片。

cues.en: But what I am gonna do here is show you, I'll just close this figure.
cues.zh: 現在要示範的是，先關掉這張圖。

cues.en: So now I'm calling the regress function in MATLAB.
cues.zh: 呼叫 MATLAB 的 regress 函式。

cues.en: So here we input the dependent variable, which is the amount of money spent on food shopping, and the design matrix.
cues.zh: 輸入依變數，也就是買食物花費金額，以及設計矩陣。

cues.en: And it's that simple.
cues.zh: 就這麼簡單。

cues.en: So, and then it gives you a bunch of outputs, it gives you the beta coefficients, the confidence intervals around the beta coefficients, residuals, I actually don't remember what this thing is,
cues.zh: 會得到許多輸出，beta 係數、係數的信賴區間、殘差，這一項我其實不記得是什麼，

cues.en: and then stats.
cues.zh: 以及 stats。

cues.en: So, let's see.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: Stats is going to be a structure.
cues.zh: stats 會是結構。

cues.en: Oh no, it's a vector, okay.
cues.zh: 喔，不，是向量。

cues.en: Easy to forget all the outputs of these things.
cues.zh: 這些輸出很容易忘。

cues.en: So, let's see.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: All right, so RINT was something about outlier detection, and then we have our STATS vector here.
cues.zh: RINT 與離群值偵測有關，接著是 STATS 向量。

cues.en: So that is a vector that contains, in the following order, so this is the R squared of the model, remember I said, in the video I showed you, that the R square was 0.36,
cues.zh: 向量依序包含：模型的 R 平方，記得影片說過是 0.36，

cues.en: the F statistic, the associated p value, and an estimate of the error variance.
cues.zh: F 統計量、對應 P 值，以及誤差變異數的估計。

cues.en: We don't really care about this too much.
cues.zh: 這最後一項，我們不太關心。

cues.en: But we do care about these first three terms, the R squared, the F ratio, and the p value of that F statistic.
cues.zh: 但關心前三項：R 平方、F 比值，以及該 F 統計量的 P 值。

cues.en: So you can see it's quite easy to do this in practice.
cues.zh: 實際做起來很容易。

cues.en: And then, this is just to show you that the beta coefficients that I computed up above, earlier in the code, are exactly the same as the beta coefficients
cues.zh: 這裡則示範，程式前面算出的 beta 係數，與 regress 函式

cues.en: that get outputted by the regress function.
cues.zh: 輸出的 beta 係數完全相同。

cues.en: Okay, so here we have all of the raw data for sleep hours, the number of hours spent sleeping, and the amount of money spent on food shopping.
cues.zh: 這裡有全部原始資料，睡眠時數與買食物花費金額。

cues.en: Here you see this plot, it's just the same thing I showed in the slides in the previous video.
cues.zh: 這張圖與上一支影片投影片的相同。

cues.en: So I'm gonna run through this regression twice, as I mentioned in the beginning of this video.
cues.zh: 如影片開頭所說，會做兩次迴歸。

cues.en: So the first time, I'm going to create my own design matrix, and then use least-squares fitting,
cues.zh: 第一次自行建立設計矩陣，再做最小平方擬合，

cues.en: where I fit the design matrix onto the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 把設計矩陣配適到依變數。

cues.en: So let me show you what this, let's see, I'm gonna print out desmat, so you can see what that looks like.
cues.zh: 示範一下，印出 desmat，看看它的樣子。

cues.en: So print design matrix.
cues.zh: 印出設計矩陣。

cues.en: And before worrying about the rest of the code, I just wanna show you what this design matrix looks like in practice.
cues.zh: 先不管其餘程式碼，先示範設計矩陣實際長什麼樣子。

cues.en: So we always have the first column be the intercept term, or the constant term, and then all of the later columns
cues.zh: 第一欄總是截距項，也就是常數項，後面各欄

cues.en: correspond to the independent variables.
cues.zh: 對應自變數。

cues.en: Now, in this case, of course, we only have one independent variable, so it's just a two-column matrix.
cues.zh: 這裡只有一個自變數，所以是兩欄矩陣。

cues.en: And here, I compute the beta coefficients as the design matrix left multiplied, or the left inverse of the design matrix times the outcome variable,
cues.zh: 這裡計算 beta 係數，將設計矩陣的左反矩陣，乘上結果變數，

cues.en: and that's what this function, least-squares, is doing.
cues.zh: 這就是最小平方函式在做的事。

cues.en: And it gives me the resulting beta coefficients, and this is what I showed in these slides.
cues.zh: 得到 beta 係數，與投影片中展示的相同。

cues.en: So the intercept was around $63, and the slope was -$2.50.
cues.zh: 截距大約 63 元，斜率負 2 元 50 分。

cues.en: Here I have the predicted data value, so this is yHat.
cues.zh: 這裡是預測資料值，也就是 yHat。

cues.en: These are the values that the model predicts for money spending based on the number of hours of sleep.
cues.zh: 模型根據睡眠時數，預測花費金額。

cues.en: So the way this works, I'm using this @ symbol here for matrix multiplication.
cues.zh: 用這裡的 @ 符號做矩陣乘法。

cues.en: This is just a little bit of a linear algebra notation to get this matrix vector multiplication to work out.
cues.zh: 這是讓矩陣向量乘法運作的一點線性代數符號。

cues.en: But what this multiplication is doing is multiplying 63.84 by the first column, which is just 1.
cues.zh: 這個乘法，把 63.84 乘上第一欄，也就是全部為 1。

cues.en: So obviously it's still, it's just the intercept, plus this column times -2.5.
cues.zh: 所以仍然是截距，再加上這一欄乘負 2.5。

cues.en: So we take the two columns of the design matrix and we sum them together, but we scale them first.
cues.zh: 取設計矩陣兩欄，先縮放，再相加。

cues.en: So the first column gets scaled by beta one, and the second column gets scaled by beta two.
cues.zh: 第一欄乘 beta1，第二欄乘 beta2。

cues.en: And then, that's, yeah, then we sum them together, and then that gives us our predicted data values, yHat.
cues.zh: 接著相加，就得到預測資料值 yHat。

cues.en: Okay, and then I'm going to plot them.
cues.zh: 然後畫圖。

cues.en: So here I plot the raw data, and here I'm plotting sleeping hours, so this was the independent variable by the predicted dependent variable.
cues.zh: 這裡畫原始資料，這裡則畫睡眠時數，也就是自變數，相對於預測依變數。

cues.en: And that gives us this plot, which you've also already seen in the slides.
cues.zh: 得到這張投影片中也看過的圖。

cues.en: So the actual data, the predicted data, notice the predicted data are much simpler than the real data, of course, because it's just a simplified model.
cues.zh: 實際資料與預測資料。當然，預測資料比真實資料簡單得多，因為只是簡化模型。

cues.en: And here we see the residuals.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到殘差。

cues.en: So, and then, just as a reminder, the idea is that this line, this best fit line, the predicted data, is designed such that the squared error terms
cues.zh: 再次提醒，這條最佳擬合線、預測資料，是設計來讓平方誤差項

cues.en: are as small as they possibly can be altogether.
cues.zh: 合起來盡可能小。

cues.en: Okay, so now, what I'm gonna show you is the way to do this a little bit more simply using the linregress function, so linear regression, in the stats toolbox.
cues.zh: 接著示範，如何用 stats 工具箱的 linregress，也就是線性迴歸函式，更簡單地完成。

cues.en: So we input the independent variable, which in this case is the number of hours slept, and the dependent variable, the amount of money spent on food shopping.
cues.zh: 輸入自變數，這裡是睡眠時數，以及依變數，買食物花費金額。

cues.en: And now, notice that I'm not actually inputting the full design matrix, nor am I inputting a intercept term here.
cues.zh: 注意，沒有輸入完整設計矩陣，也沒有輸入截距項。

cues.en: So linregress will actually assume a intercept, so it will put in an intercept for you.
cues.zh: linregress 會假設有截距，自行替你加入。

cues.en: You don't have to specify that yourself.
cues.zh: 不需要自己指定。

cues.en: Okay, and then I'm going to print out, basically, the intercept and slope.
cues.zh: 接著印出截距與斜率。

cues.en: These are the outputs of the linregress function.
cues.zh: 這些是 linregress 的輸出。

cues.en: And then, this beta vector is what I computed above.
cues.zh: 這個 beta 向量，是上面算出的。

cues.en: And you see they're the same.
cues.zh: 可以看到，兩者相同。

cues.en: So the intercept output from the linregress function is the same as the first beta coefficient.
cues.zh: linregress 輸出的截距，等於第一個 beta 係數。

cues.en: And the slope here is the same as the second term that I computed above, in the code, and that's the beta coefficient
cues.zh: 斜率等於程式碼中算出的第二項，也就是 beta 係數，

cues.en: for the effect of hours slept on money spending on food shopping.
cues.zh: 表示睡眠時數對買食物花費的效果。
